caption: The drawing features a large ceramic jug with a wide, slightly flared rim, a rounded body, and a sturdy handle attached to the side. The jug has a marbled surface colored in earthy shades of brown, reddish-brown, and hints of green, giving it a natural, mottled appearance. To the upper left of the jug, there is a small inset labeled "DETAIL OF HANDLE," which shows a close-up, vertically-oriented section of the jug’s handle with the same marbled hues. Near the bottom right, there is an incised design illustration labeled "INCISED DESIGN," depicting three stylized birds: two smaller birds facing opposite directions on a branch, and a larger bird below with outstretched wings, all rendered in brown outlining. The artist's name, "JESSICA PRICE," is printed in small, unobtrusive capital letters near the lower left of the drawing. The background is plain and light-colored, providing contrast to the objects and designs depicted.
title: Red Earthenware Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
